name: Viceroy Los Cabos
insider_take: Where desert meets sea in dramatic fashion, creating Los Cabos' most sophisticated beachfront sanctuary.
whats_special: Viceroy Los Cabos sits on the exclusive San José del Cabo corridor, featuring the region's longest swimmable beach. The resort's striking architecture mirrors the dramatic desert landscape, while the infinity pools seem to blend seamlessly with the Sea of Cortez. This area is also famous for being where Jacques Cousteau called the waters "the world's aquarium" due to incredible marine biodiversity.
pro_tip: Visit during whale watching season (December-April) when gray and humpback whales migrate through these waters - you can often spot them right from the resort's beachfront.
dont_miss: The iconic Land's End rock formations at Cabo's tip, just 20 minutes away, where the Pacific Ocean meets the Sea of Cortez. Also explore nearby San José del Cabo's charming Art District with its Thursday evening Art Walk, featuring local galleries and authentic Mexican cuisine.
pros: Contemporary luxury design with stunning ocean views
Multiple dining venues with exceptional cuisine
Prime beachfront location in Los Cabos
